scope: local MCP stdio software protocol with synthetic business dispatch only
preconditions: one completed source-bound G01 metadata observer record tied to the exact current binding
separate Root one-use runtime decision and independent review of frozen executable scripts and finite guard policy
fresh attempt directory and COMSOL_SERVER_MCP_HOME under the task-owned output root
Python 3.12.13, MCP 1.30.0, AnyIO 4.15.1, full public profile

cases.input: real JSON-RPC initialize request with integer id; notifications/initialized; subsequent string ids
cases.check: negotiated session stays usable across list, calls, malformed input, and ping

cases.input: actual tools/list through production main and installed SDK; follow actual nextCursor values up to the 8-page cap
cases.check: aggregate every received page before lookup or equality; detect duplicate tool names and cursors; compare the complete 112-row aggregate with the accepted G01 observer schemas only after no nextCursor remains

cases.input: tools/list request with explicit cursor probe, then follow each actual nextCursor value up to 8 total pages
cases.check: record actual advertised/accepted behavior; if a cursor remains at the cap, preserve OPEN/incomplete status and do not claim complete G01 equality or whole-wire PASS; retain multipage OPEN when unsupported
structuredContent preserves refusal and isError true

cases.synthetic: success true plus execution_state_unknown true and cleanup_failed true

cases.check: partial data retained; not represented as full success
generic invalid-backend error and isError true
wire, stderr and actual file logs do not contain the sentinel; isError true

cases.input: after aggregating actual tools/list pages, choose a returned tool with at least one required input and omit it
cases.check: isError true and dispatcher call count unchanged; if an incomplete capped list contains no required-input tool, record NOT_RUN and retain OPEN/incomplete status

cases.input: server_info with one unexpected top-level key
cases.synthetic: observe if SDK/model rejects or ignores; do not assume
cases.check: accept only actual reject-before-dispatch with count 0 and an error, or ignored-extra dispatch with count 1 and a successful response; retain the actual response and count
record response and whether dispatch occurred

cases.input: experiment_stage_define with a version-2 definition whose nested stage has an unknown key and omits required fields
cases.check: actual FastMCP input-schema validation error and dispatcher count unchanged; no control dispatcher invocation

cases.input: tools/call for a name absent from G01 tool list
cases.check: actual SDK error response and dispatcher count unchanged

cases.input: one literal non-JSON line followed by a ping request
cases.check: preserve every output/notification; ping proves session continuation; no non-JSON stdout

cases.input: registry_list limit 1 with cursor empty, then repeat using the exact returned next_cursor
cases.check: cursor and structured page data survive transport across two pages; transport-only evidence

cases.input: close the sole child stdin after finite cases
cases.check: actual SDK returns on EOF; capture loop/socket/thread join state, child PID/SID/exit/reap; retain partial evidence on failures

explicitly_open: MCP tools/list multi-page pagination when no nextCursor is advertised or page following is incomplete
